== Biography ==
=== 2015 Season ===
Placed directly into the finals of the gauntlet-style [[LMS/2015 Season/Summer Playoffs|playoffs]], they once again won the season, this time beating Hong Kong Esports 3-0 and automatically qualifying for the [[2015 Season World Championship]].

At Worlds, ahq were seeded into Group B, along with [[Fnatic]], [[Invictus Gaming]], and [[Cloud9]] and went 3-3, advancing to the playoffs after a tiebreaker victory over Cloud9 (giving the North American team their fourth loss in a row that day). Their World Championship run ended in the quarterfinals, where they were drawn against tournament favorites [[SK Telecom]], earning a top 8 finish.

=== 2019 Season ===
On September 18, 2019, it was announced that An would retire by the end of September.<ref>[https://www.ahq.com.tw/news/11129.html 謝謝你帶來的精彩！An將於9/30正式退役 (Chinese)] ''ahq.com.tw''</ref><ref>[https://www.facebook.com/Ohreallol/posts/2316411428467407 An's Facebook Post (Chinese)] ''facebook.com''</ref>

On September 30, 2019, An officially retired.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/ahqeSportsClub/posts/1983580798411246 ahq e-Sports Club's Facebook Post (Chinese)] ''facebook.com''</ref>

=== 2021 Season ===
After not playing competitively for the entirety of 2020, AN came out of retirement to join [[Alpha Esports]] for [[PCS/2021 Season/Spring Season|PCS 2021 Spring]].
